model.source_terms: A_C/A_M must be explicitly bound with temporal role; zero is not a default. No ungoverned flow/advection term may be added or silently omitted.
model.surface_history: Conditional zero-order hold of T0 model boundary as approximation, with deterministic existing-range endpoint sensitivity; not physical constancy
model.base_history: Conditional hold of initializer-compatible model-domain base as approximation; HWR zp and adiabat are not universal physical LAB or a world-time history
model.ocean_support: Positive-age HWR columns require separately bound age/support-in-time adapter. Ridge/zero-age cells use their separate rule; unsupported class/identity change fails closed.
model.sufficiency_gate: Before provider execution, adjudicate boundary sensitivity at intended support/depth and pre-event advection, geometry/interface migration, lower-crust flow and material/source terms. Current result unresolved.
